subject: Multiple duplicate orders appearing in system for same customer
description: Store manager reports that customers are receiving duplicate order confirmations and being charged multiple times for single orders placed through the online ordering platform. Between 09:15 and 10:10 AM today, at least 3 customers complained about receiving 2-3 identical orders with separate order IDs and payment deductions. The Cisco router RTR-0008-01 is handling the order routing for this location. Immediate investigation needed to identify the root cause and prevent further customer impact.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and reviewed. Confirmed duplicate order pattern with store manager. Escalated to Network team for router diagnostics and to Order Management team for database transaction review.
